name: Math tools
summary: Calculator, primes, combinations, equations, geometry and fractions
author: friday-core
description: Exact maths that a language model would otherwise guess. It holds 6 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Calculator: Evaluates an arithmetic expression with its own parser: powers, roots, logs, trig, factorials. Number theory: GCD and LCM, primality, prime factors, divisors, Fibonacci and primes up to N. Combinatorics: Factorials, nCr, nPr and distinct arrangements of a word, exact for any size. Equation solver: Linear and quadratic equations (complex roots included) and two linear equations. Geometry: Area, perimeter, volume and surface of common shapes and right-triangle sides. Fractions and ratios: Simplify and combine fractions, decimal to fraction, and split an amount by a ratio.
